description_en: Enables or disables the auto-renewal feature for a card. This operation applies only to single-card plans and same-tier pool plans
description_zh: 该接口用于开启或关闭卡的自动续费功能，仅适用于单卡套餐和同档位池套餐
name: UpdateAutoRechargeSwitch

parameters.description_en:

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card or on the Card Management page of the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8).
